origins.section: 15.1 The Host Starts Network Messages Too, and Each One Needs Its Own Answer
15.2 A Refused Sign-On Waits Longer Each Time
15.3 One Lost Echo Is Not a Dead Host
15.4 Drain a Link Before You Sign It Off

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-host-sign-off-unanswered: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-host-sign-off-unanswered: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-host-sign-off-unanswered: 15.1 says the 002 went to <unhandled> unanswered, the logon mark still holds, the host answers every echo, the enabled mark stays and the host declines A's share of the purchases 'until the logon mark expires'.
recorded.prompt:q-backoff-cap: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-backoff-cap: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-backoff-cap: 15.2 says 'The cap is also the longest a link can stay out after its host has recovered', and the example has the host ready at 9 s with A back at 16.5 s; applying this to a 10-minute cap is a short inference.
recorded.prompt:q-echo-limit-hung-host: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-echo-limit-hung-host: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-echo-limit-hung-host: 15.3 says 'Each failure the limit allows adds one echo timeout, plus a pass', and gives the example '30 seconds and a limit of 3' giving 'more than a minute and a half'; 4 x 20 s x 3 purchases/s = 240 is a short arithmetic inference.
recorded.prompt:q-stop-without-drain: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stop-without-drain: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stop-without-drain: 15.4 shows the same case: the answer was 'lost: the connection is closed', the caller 'waited out its 5-second timeout, got null', and 'has to reverse a purchase that went through'.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:b: 15.1 says 'the host answers every echo, and the enabled mark stays', so echoes do not take the link out.
recorded.prompt:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:c: 15.1 says 'QMUX hands it straight to its request listeners' and it 'went on to <unhandled>', so QMUX does not answer it or remove the mark itself.
recorded.prompt:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-host-sign-off-unanswered:d: 15.1 says 'The adaptor doesn't read it either, and the connection stays open.'
recorded.prompt:q-backoff-cap:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-backoff-cap:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-backoff-cap:b: 15.2 says to 'stop at a cap', and 15.2.1 says no refusal count 'can produce more than the cap'.
recorded.prompt:q-backoff-cap:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-backoff-cap:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-backoff-cap:c: The 15.2 example shows the host ready at 9 s but A back only at 16.5 s, so the client's wait is not reset when the host recovers.
recorded.prompt:q-backoff-cap:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-backoff-cap:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-backoff-cap:d: Short inference: 15.2 contrasts the backoff with 'c11's loop, which asks on every pass', and says the cap bounds the time out, so at the cap the manager waits the cap and does not retry every pass.
recorded.prompt:q-echo-limit-hung-host:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-echo-limit-hung-host:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-echo-limit-hung-host:b: 15.3 says to 'take the link out only at a limit', and the limit-2 run shows the link stayed in after one failure.
recorded.prompt:q-echo-limit-hung-host:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-echo-limit-hung-host:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-echo-limit-hung-host:c: 15.3 says 'Until the limit is reached the link stays in the pool, and every purchase sent to it is an unknown outcome', and the hang runs count purchases with no answer.
recorded.prompt:q-echo-limit-hung-host:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-echo-limit-hung-host:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-echo-limit-hung-host:d: Short inference: the 15.3 hang runs show purchases sent to A with no answer while echoes were pending, so nothing holds the purchases back.
recorded.prompt:q-stop-without-drain:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stop-without-drain:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stop-without-drain:b: 15.4 says 'The host approved the purchase' and that the caller must reverse 'a purchase that went through', so the host did not discard it and resending would be wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-stop-without-drain:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stop-without-drain:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stop-without-drain:c: In 15.4's first run Q2 stopped at 0.3 s, before the answer at 1.5 s, and 15.4 says c11's stop 'does nothing about requests already on the link'.
recorded.prompt:q-stop-without-drain:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stop-without-drain:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stop-without-drain:d: 15.4 shows the answer 'lost: the connection is closed' and 'purchase -> null'.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
